root_cause: E1 analyzer used abs(cp_x) instead of support_position_error_m column

e1_analyzer_used.calculation: absolute value of capture point x coordinate

metric_definitions.relationship: cp_x is NOT the same as support_center error. cp_x is the raw capture point x position, while support_position_error_m is the error between support_center and its reference.

fix_required.action: Fix E1 analyzer to use support_position_error_m column
fix_required.old_code: support_pos_err = np.abs(df['cp_x'].values) if 'cp_x' in df.columns else np.abs(df['com_error_x'].values)
fix_required.new_code: support_pos_err = np.abs(df['support_position_error_m'].values) if 'support_position_error_m' in df.columns else np.abs(df['com_error_x'].values)

phase_4_action: Fix E1 analyzer to use correct support_position_error_m column
